title: The gate reads an unreadable state file as empty, which fails open
description:
Found by the Stage 1 review of opum-ai/test-skills#33 (TS-24, DEC-195 (7)(a)), verdict finding 2.

test_gate_matrix.py:56-59 now records that a corrupt .test-quarantine.json produces zero violations. That is fail-open: _load_list and _load_list_text swallow ValueError and return [], so a state file the gate cannot read silently reads as empty. A corrupt quarantine file un-quarantines flakes; a corrupt probation file un-demotes probation tests. The project's own principle, stated when the stale-baseline check landed under DEC-209, is the opposite: a state that cannot be checked never passes.

Scope: decide whether an unreadable quarantine, probation or baseline file should fail by name (the fail-closed reading), implement it, and INVERT the assertion at test_gate_matrix.py:56-59 rather than keep it. Any new collected case is a measured slot request; inverting an existing assertion costs no slot.

acceptanceCriteria.text: An unreadable .test-quarantine.json or .test-probation.json makes the gate fail by name, naming the file, rather than reading it as empty.
The assertion at test_gate_matrix.py:56-59 expects that named failure, so the previous fail-open behaviour can no longer pass the suite.
